text: Ay, when I think what she’ll say to me now without a mossel of red in her face, it do seem strange that ’a wouldn’t say such a little thing then.... However, then she went on, and that’s what made me bring up the story, ‘Well, whatever clothes I’ve won, white or figured, for eyes to see or for eyes not to see’ (’a could do a pretty stroke of modesty in those days), ‘I’d sooner have lost it than have seen what I have. Poor Mr. Yeobright was took bad directly he reached the fair ground, and was forced to go home again.’ That was the last time he ever went out of the parish.” “’A faltered on from one day to another, and then we heard he was gone.” “D’ye think he had great pain when ’a died?” said Christian. “O no—quite different. Nor any pain of mind.
